options.content:
◉ Eye in the Sky · Estate Control
Every managed service on one board. Rows link to the tenant view; ticket counts and Escalate open ServiceNow; the SRE link (top right) drops into the drill-down control tower.

panels.title: Healthy apps

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total{code="500"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total[5m])), 0.001)) < 3) or vector(0)

panels.description: Managed apps with a 5xx error rate below 3%.

panels.title: Warning apps

targets.expr: count(((100 * sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total{code="500"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total[5m])), 0.001)) >= 3) and ((100 * sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total{code="500"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total[5m])), 0.001)) < 10)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Managed apps with a 5xx error rate between 3% and 10%.

panels.title: Critical apps

targets.expr: count((100 * sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total{code="500"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (app_id) (rate(tenant_app_requests_total[5m])), 0.001)) >= 10) or vector(0)

panels.description: Managed apps with a 5xx error rate at or above 10%.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: PrometheusRule alerts firing for a managed app right now (error-rate and latency rules).

panels.title: Config changes

targets.query: message:(config OR change OR deploy OR rollout)

panels.description: Config-change, deploy and rollout records in the audit log over the dashboard window, estate-wide. These are the change events the RCA correlates against incidents (changes are the leading cause of the seeded faults).

panels.title: Upstream-svc changes

targets.query: message:(config OR change OR deploy) AND app_id:(payments-api OR inventory-service)

panels.description: The subset of those change records that landed on an upstream service (payments-api, inventory-service). A change to a shared upstream carries a wider blast radius, so it is called out separately.

panels.title: Agent control tower: RCA lifecycle metrics and the incidents Olly is tracking
HITL pending
panels.description: Triages parked for human approval (P1/P2 and low confidence). The approver identity is a label on olly_hitl_pending; stuck approvals are an alerting target.

panels.title: Pipeline stage latency p90 (last 1h)
panels.description: Per-stage p90 RCA timings over the last hour from olly_stage_duration_seconds: consume, context, mcp_fanout, correlate, llm_rca, publish. A snapshot rather than a timeline, because RCA runs are on-demand and a rate-based line goes gappy between them; the sub-15-minute time-to-RCA target is the sum across these stages.

panels.title: Tokens / hr
panels.description: Token usage via the gateway shim (Gemini via ARC in the client estate), for cost and reasoning-quality tracking.

panels.title: Incident backlog by tenant
panels.description: Open incident backlog per tenant app, stacked by lifecycle state in flow order (new -> in_progress -> enriched), counted from the olly-incidents index. The throughput panel to the left shows the flow over time; this shows the standing balance. 24h look-back.

panels.title: Individual incidents across tenants
panels.description: Every incident the IO Mapping Service is tracking (olly-incidents index), across all tenant apps. state=enriched means Olly has posted an RCA. Click an INC to open that exact record in ServiceNow. 24h look-back so the startup-seeded incidents stay visible.

panels.title: Efficiency vs manual triage (no enrichment)
panels.description: agent RCA p90 vs a 1-hour manual baseline
